## Checklist

- [ ] I kept implemented and planned behavior clearly separated.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for implemented behavior.
- [ ] I documented changed contracts, formats, or decisions.
- [ ] I included reproducible evidence for performance claims.
- [ ] I preserved native cube authority and did not introduce a core dependency on column or NeoForge compatibility layers.
- [ ] I did not implement a core runtime feature as a removable built-in mod.
- [ ] I did not include vanilla or patched Minecraft JARs, generated Minecraft source, Minecraft assets, game files, or secrets.
- [ ] I documented the source, license, and distribution implications of every new upstream dependency or patch format.
- [ ] I read and followed the AI-Assisted Contribution Policy, understand everything submitted, and have a current private AI-use profile where required.
